verdict.rationale: AutoGen is an open-source pip-installable framework (autogen-agentchat) that runs locally against any LLM endpoint, executes code in locally-spun-up Docker containers by default, and AutoGen Studio supports running teams in a docker container, indicating vendor-independent self-hosted operation. Community evidence corroborates local docker-based execution as default behavior. missing for 10: explicit enterprise self-hosting/deployment documentation and independent confirmation of full offline/air-gapped operation.
